keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria has no Boii row and the page has no infobox area. Emilia (Felsina/Bologna, Mutina, Parma) without Rimini, held by the Senones from 390 (senones dossier); the Utens is the Senones frontier. About 21,200 km2 by the gazetteer, whose Emilia reaches the Adriatic coast (12.39E) east of the Utens, so the east is an overshoot; soft edges.

notes: New state. Emilia from the Gallic invasion of 396 (from etruscans) to Scipio Nasica's victory of 191 (to roman-republic). The Roman submission of 225-218 is tinted from the roman-republic dossier. The roman-republic -218 loss names 'boii' for the whole Po valley rising, which the Insubres share. Wikidata Q131248 is the general Boii item (unverified). Revised 2026-10-19 after review: every Emilia region is now Emilia minus Rimini (the Senones' Rimini; Livy's Utens is the boundary); vassal_start 225 and vassal_end 218 (month 11) added to match roman-republic /ledger/51 and /58, with a gain in November 218 mirroring roman-republic's loss to the Boii (/ledger/57); the 225 contest now ends at the submission (225) so that contest and vassal tint do not overlap; the 191 loss stays whole Emilia (the page: Rome 'took only about half their territory', not placed); three keyframes added. Wikidata Q131248 was from memory and could not be checked (wikidata.org unreachable); set to null on 2026-10-19.
